Text: new PIXI.Text({ text, style }); stroke { color, width } and dropShadow { ... } styles; gradient fills via js/text-gradient.js (FillGradient); CanvasTextMetrics

BaseTexture -> TextureSource/CanvasSource, new Texture({ source, frame }), string blend/scale modes, Color for string2hex, generateTexture({ target, frame }), render({ container, target, transform }), extract.pixels output, BlurFilter options, Filter.defaultOptions.resolution = 'inherit', defaultAnchor objects, label for display names

js/pixi-fixes.js works around two Pixi 8.22 behaviours: sprites sized before their texture loads keep that size (Pixi 7 re-applied width/height on texture update; a garden bed became 51,000px wide and blacked out the street), and paths continuing after an arc start at its real end point (getLastPoint read the wrong slots: Rainbow Run bands and the rook HUD health arc vanished)
